> Pharmacy: the queue, the counter, returns and the dashboard (PI-7). The standard chain, and the order IS the security model: requireTenant -> authenticate -> requireAuth -> authorize -> validate -> handler ── WHICH CODE GATES WHAT, AND WHY ────────────────────────────────────────── the queue, a prescription, a dispense, substitutions -> `pharmacy.dispense.read` verifying a prescription, or standing it down -> `pharmacy.dispense.verify` supplying, and a counter sale -> `pharmacy.dispense.create` taking something back -> `pharmacy.dispense.return` ⚠️ `.verify` IS NEW IN PI-7 AND `PHARMACIST` HOLDS IT ALONGSIDE `.create`.
